profile.registerNotes: Vouvoyez the candidate (vous). In role-plays use tu only between friends. Standard metropolitan French.

2: a current event in your country
2+: advantages and disadvantages of a policy
a problem in your community and its causes
3: supporting an opinion on an abstract issue
hypothetical: what if your country changed a major policy
the role of technology in society

rolePlaySeeds: Check into a hotel and solve a problem with the reservation (interviewer: receptionist).
Buy a train ticket after the train you wanted was cancelled (interviewer: ticket agent).
Report a lost passport at a police station (interviewer: police officer).
Arrange a meeting time with a colleague whose schedule keeps changing (interviewer: colleague).
Persuade a landlord to fix a broken heater before winter (interviewer: landlord).
Brief a local official about a joint exercise that will close a road (interviewer: town official).
Explain a misunderstanding between two delegations as their interpreter (interviewer: delegation leader).
At a checkpoint, explain why your convoy must pass before noon (interviewer: checkpoint officer).

rolePlays.situation: You are trying to check into a hotel, but the reservation is not under your name.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, comment puis-je vous aider?
rolePlays.english: Hello, how can I help you?

rolePlays.situation: You need to buy a train ticket, but the train you wanted to take has been cancelled.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, que puis-je faire pour vous?
rolePlays.english: Hello, what can I do for you?

rolePlays.situation: You have lost your passport and need to report it to the police.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, en quoi puis-je vous être utile?
rolePlays.english: Hello, how can I be of assistance?

rolePlays.situation: You are trying to arrange a meeting time with a colleague, but their schedule keeps changing.
rolePlays.opening: Salut! Alors, tu voulais qu'on se voie?
rolePlays.english: Hi! So, you wanted to meet up?

rolePlays.situation: You are the interpreter for a French delegation meeting with a German delegation. There seems to be a misunderstanding about the meeting time. Please clarify the situation.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je crois qu'il y a eu une petite confusion concernant l'heure de notre réunion. Pourriez-vous m'aider à éclaircir cela?
rolePlays.english: Hello, I think there has been a small misunderstanding about the time of our meeting. Could you help me clarify this?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a checkpoint with your convoy. You need to explain to the officer that your convoy must pass before noon.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, nous avons besoin de faire passer notre convoi avant midi. Est-ce que ce sera possible?
rolePlays.english: Hello, we need to get our convoy through before noon. Will that be possible?

rolePlays.situation: You are trying to persuade your landlord to fix the broken heater before winter starts. The landlord is hesitant.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je vous appelle parce que le chauffage est cassé. Il fait très froid la nuit, et l'hiver arrive bientôt. Pouvez-vous le réparer soon?
rolePlays.english: Hello, I'm calling because the heating is broken. It's very cold at night, and winter is coming soon. Can you fix it soon?

rolePlays.situation: You are a town official. A local resident wants to inform you about a joint exercise that will close a main road for a few hours. Please discuss the details.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je suis désolé de vous déranger, mais il y a un exercice conjoint qui aura lieu demain. La rue principale sera fermée pendant quelques heures. Pouvez-vous m'aider à organiser cela?
rolePlays.english: Hello, I'm sorry to bother you, but there is a joint exercise taking place tomorrow. The main street will be closed for a few hours. Can you help me organize this?

rolePlays.situation: You are a liaison officer for a multinational exercise. You need to brief a local town official about a joint exercise that will close a main road for a few hours. The official is concerned about the impact on local businesses.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je suis le maire de cette ville. Je comprends que vous avez besoin de fermer la rue principale pour un exercice, mais pourriez-vous m'en dire plus sur la manière dont cela affectera nos commerces locaux ?
rolePlays.english: Good morning, I am the mayor of this town. I understand that you need to close the main street for an exercise, but could you tell me more about how this will affect our local businesses?

rolePlays.situation: You are trying to arrange a meeting time with a colleague from another department. Your colleague's schedule keeps changing, and you need to find a time that works for both of you.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je sais que mon emploi du temps a été un peu chaotique récemment. Pourriez-vous me dire quels sont les moments qui vous conviennent le mieux cette semaine ?
rolePlays.english: Good morning, I know my schedule has been a bit chaotic recently. Could you tell me what times work best for you this week?

rolePlays.situation: You are at a checkpoint with your convoy. You need to explain to the officer that your convoy must pass before noon due to a time-sensitive mission.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je vois que vous avez un convoi ici. Pouvez-vous me dire pourquoi il est si important qu'il passe avant midi aujourd'hui ?
rolePlays.english: Good morning, I see that you have a convoy here. Can you tell me why it is so important that it passes before noon today?

rolePlays.situation: You are trying to persuade your landlord to fix the broken heater before winter starts. The landlord is hesitant due to the cost.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je comprends que le chauffeage est cassé, mais les réparations coûtent cher. Pourquoi ne pas attendre jusqu'à ce que nous ayons plus d'argent ?
rolePlays.english: Good morning, I understand that the heater is broken, but the repairs are expensive. Why don't we wait until we have more money?

rolePlays.situation: You are checking into a hotel, but there seems to be an issue with your reservation.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, comment puis-je vous aider aujourd'hui?
rolePlays.english: Hello, how can I help you today?

rolePlays.situation: You need to buy a train ticket, but the train you wanted to take has been cancelled. You need to find an alternative.
rolePlays.opening: Billetterie, que puis-je faire pour vous?
rolePlays.english: Ticket office, how can I assist you?

rolePlays.situation: You need to report a lost passport at the police station.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, en quoi puis-je vous aider?
rolePlays.english: Hello, how can I assist you?

rolePlays.situation: You are a liaison officer for a multinational exercise. You need to brief a local town official about a joint exercise that will close a main road for a few hours. The official is concerned about the impact on local businesses.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, j'ai entendu parler d'un exercice conjoint qui pourrait affecter notre ville. Pouvez-vous m'en dire plus?
rolePlays.english: Hello, I've heard about a joint exercise that could affect our town. Can you tell me more?

rolePlays.situation: You are an interpreter for two delegations who are having trouble communicating due to a misunderstanding. The leader of one delegation wants to know what the other delegation is saying.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, pourriez-vous m'expliquer ce qui se passe? Il semble y avoir une confusion entre les deux délégations.
rolePlays.english: Hello, could you explain to me what is going on? It seems there is a misunderstanding between the two delegations.

rolePlays.situation: You need to explain to a checkpoint officer that your convoy must pass before noon due to a time-sensitive mission. The officer is concerned about the traffic it will cause.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je dois faire passer mon convoi avant midi en raison d'une mission urgente. Pourriez-vous nous laisser passer?
rolePlays.english: Hello, I need to pass my convoy before noon due to an urgent mission. Could you let us pass?

rolePlays.situation: You are a journalist who wants to interview a famous author. The author's assistant is trying to schedule the interview but is having trouble finding a time that works for both parties.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je suis l'assistant(e) de l'auteur. Nous avons du mal à trouver un moment pour l'interview. Pourriez-vous nous aider à trouver un créneau?
rolePlays.english: Hello, I am the author's assistant. We are having trouble finding a time for the interview. Could you help us find a slot?

rolePlays.situation: You are trying to arrange a meeting time with a colleague from another department. Your colleague's schedule keeps changing, and you need to find a time that works for both of you.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, je sais que ton emploi du temps change souvent. Pourrions-nous essayer de trouver un moment pour nous rencontrer?
rolePlays.english: Hello, I know your schedule changes often. Could we try to find a time to meet?

rolePlays.situation: You need to persuade your landlord to fix a broken heater before winter. The landlord is reluctant because of the cost and because it is not yet winter.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, comment puis-je vous aider aujourd'hui?
rolePlays.english: Hello, how can I help you today?

rolePlays.situation: You are a military officer at a checkpoint. You need to explain to the officer that your convoy must pass before noon due to a time-sensitive mission. The officer is concerned about the traffic it will cause.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, comment puis-je vous aider aujourd'hui? Avez-vous vos documents d'identification prêts?
rolePlays.english: Hello, how can I help you today? Do you have your identification documents ready?

rolePlays.situation: You are a journalist who wants to interview a famous author. The author's assistant is trying to schedule the interview but is having trouble finding a time that works for both parties.
rolePlays.opening: Bonjour, comment puis-je vous aider aujourd'hui? Vous souhaitez parler à l'auteur, n'est-ce pas?
rolePlays.english: Hello, how can I help you today? You wish to speak to the author, don't you?

rolePlays.situation: You are trying to arrange a meeting time with a colleague from another department. Your colleague's schedule keeps changing, and you need to find a time that works for both of you.

rolePlays.english: Hello, I am sorry for the constant changes in my schedule. When would you like to meet?

0+: I can greet people and say my name.
I can give numbers, prices, days and times.
I can answer very simple questions with memorized phrases.
1: I can make simple sentences about myself, my family and my daily routine.
I can ask and answer simple questions about familiar topics.
I can handle basic needs: ordering food, buying a ticket, asking for directions.
1+: I can describe places and people in connected sentences.
I can tell what happened on a recent trip or weekend.
I can handle routine situations even when something small goes wrong.
2: I can narrate past, present and future events in paragraphs.
I can describe and explain concrete topics at work and in the news.
I can resolve a complication in a role-play, like a cancelled reservation.
2+: I can often support my opinions with reasons and examples.
I can discuss some abstract topics, although I sometimes break down.
I can explain the causes and effects of a problem in my community.
3: I can support and defend opinions on abstract and unfamiliar topics.
I can hypothesize about situations that did not happen.
I can speak at length with good control of grammar and vocabulary.
